outcome: Time from placement of misoprostol to delivery
Time from active phase to delivery
cohort: 200 women admitted for cervical ripening at 37 weeks gestation or greater with intact membranes, singleton fetus, cephalic presentation, and Bishop score 6 or less.
finding: Cervical ripening using misoprostol in combination with a transcervical Foley bulb significantly shortened the time to delivery compared to misoprostol alone.
birth_weight: Not mentioned, but no difference between groups
